modules.title: 一封活动邮件怎样变成可用的日历字段
邮件内容怎样变成可校验字段

items.title: 先定结构
items.text: 产品指定标题、日期、地点等字段；schema 写清字段名、类型和必填项。

items.title: 按约定返回数据
items.text: 模型按这个结构返回数据；这里用 JSON 表示，但也可以有其他受约束的数据形式。

items.title: 再做业务检查
items.text: 产品还要确认日期可解析、地点有效，才写入日历或继续下一步。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: JSON 只是数据的编码形式；即使格式和 schema 都通过，也不说明邮件里的日期和地点一定真实可用。

lessonPractice.title: 页面要把模型结果显示成任务卡片。哪种返回方式最容易稳定处理？

options.label: 要求符合任务字段 schema 的结构化结果，并校验必填字段
options.feedback: 对。字段固定后，程序才能可靠地渲染、校验和处理缺失值。

options.label: 让模型写一段自然语言，再用字符串规则猜标题和截止日
options.feedback: 自然语言格式容易变化，解析规则会脆弱且难以发现遗漏。

options.label: 让模型直接返回整张任务卡片的 HTML
options.feedback: 模型生成的展示 HTML 难以安全校验；应返回数据，再由界面负责渲染。

en.title: A page must render model results as task cards. Which return format is most reliable?

options.label: Request structured output matching a task-field schema and validate required fields
options.feedback: Correct. Stable fields let software render, validate, and handle omissions reliably.

options.label: Ask for prose and guess title and due date with string rules
options.feedback: Natural-language formats change, making parsing brittle and omissions hard to detect.

options.label: Ask the model to return full task-card HTML
options.feedback: Model-generated display HTML is hard to validate safely; return data and let the UI render it.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让任务提取功能返回固定结构：title 是必填文字，dueDate 是 YYYY-MM-DD 或 null，owner 是文字或 null，status 只能是 todo、doing、done。使用前拒绝缺少 title、非法日期和未知 status；缺截止日时保留 null，不要猜。分别用完整、缺截止日和非法状态三条输入测试。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make task extraction return a fixed shape: title is required text; dueDate is YYYY-MM-DD or null; owner is text or null; status is one of todo, doing, done. Reject a missing title, invalid date, or unknown status before use; keep an absent due date as null rather than guessing. Test complete, no-date, and invalid-status inputs.

learning.assumes: You have used a form, calendar, or feature that fills in information automatically.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish structured output, JSON, and business validation.

modules.title: Turn an event email into usable calendar fields
How text becomes data a program can check

items.title: Define the shape
items.text: Specify fields such as title, date, and location before asking the model to extract them.

items.title: Return the agreed fields
items.text: The model returns data in the required structure rather than a free-form summary.

items.title: Validate before use
items.text: The product checks the schema and real business rules before filling a form or creating an event.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Valid JSON and a matching schema do not prove that a date or location is real or usable.
